Job Description: Agentic AI Engineer (Trending IT Skills)

Company: Vorizo Infotech
Role: Agentic AI Engineer / Developer (open to Lead and Architect levels)
Experience: 5 to 15 years




How to apply Email: rakeshm@vorizoit.com WhatsApp: 7032046739 Subject: Agentic AI Engineer | 5 to 15 Years




About the role
We are looking for experienced IT professionals who want to build the next generation of AI-driven software. You will design and deliver agentic AI solutions: systems where AI agents plan, use tools, work with enterprise data and complete multi-step tasks with human oversight.

Key Result Areas (KRA)

Agent development: design and build AI agents and multi-agent workflows that automate business processes.
LLM integration: integrate LLMs into applications using prompt and context engineering, tool / function calling and RAG.
Platform and integration: connect agents to enterprise systems, databases and APIs, including through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Quality and safety: test and evaluate agent behaviour, and put guardrails, monitoring and human-in-the-loop checks in place.
Delivery: deliver production-ready, secure and scalable solutions on cloud platforms with CI/CD.
Collaboration and growth: work with product, QA and business teams, mentor juniors, and keep up with new AI tools and practices.

Key Performance Areas (KPA)

On-time delivery of agent features and releases
Accuracy, reliability and task success rate of the agents built
Quality of prompts, retrieval (RAG) and tool integrations
Cost, latency and performance of AI workloads
Security, data privacy and responsible-AI compliance
Defect rate, code quality and documentation
Reusability of agent components and frameworks
Team collaboration and knowledge sharing

Mandatory skills

Strong programming in Python, Java or Node.js, with REST APIs and microservices
Hands-on experience building LLM-based or agentic AI applications
Prompt engineering, RAG and tool / function calling
Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Spring AI or LangChain4j
Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, pgvector or similar) and SQL / NoSQL databases
Git, CI/CD and Agile delivery

Good to have

Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent orchestration
LLM evaluation, observability and LLMOps tools
Cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)
Docker, Kubernetes and cloud experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Fine-tuning basics and AI security and guardrails

Other trending roles we hire for

AI Agent Developer
GenAI Solution Architect
LLMOps / AI Platform Engineer
MCP / AI Integration Engineer
AI Test and Evaluation Engineer
Prompt and Context Engineer

How to apply
Email: rakeshm@vorizoit.com
WhatsApp: 7032046739
Subject: Agentic AI Engineer | 5 to 15 Years
